name: bugfix
description: Diagnoses a defect, proves the fix, and reviews the result.

stages.purpose: Diagnose the root cause before changing code.
Write the failing repro first, then the passing fix.
Adversarial review of the fix against the diagnosis.

rules: Do not begin a stage until the previous stage's artifact is complete and its evidence block is filled.
Run the prove stage twice: first to encode the failing repro, then to encode the passing fix.
If the fix changes the original symptom instead of removing it, return to the recover stage before continuing.
completion: Done when the review artifact is empty of unresolved high-severity findings against the diagnosis.
